sourceWindows: CURRENT WINDOW: Boards of Canada's May 2026 Inferno supplied exact-track descriptions of rhythmically synchronized voice fragments, evolving rock-beat construction, low-slung downtempo and unusual phrase lengths. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/boards-of-canada-inferno/

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: BEAM WONG's August 2026 Bangkok release supplied exact track titles inside an improvisatory, reactive electronic construction with juddering disjunctions and floating chords; release-level evidence is not treated as track-specific direction. https://beamwongandfriends.bandcamp.com/album/flourishing-on-the-brink-of-collapse

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Theo Parrish's 2020 Wuddaji supplied three exact percussion-led tracks with broken-beat destabilization, late-arriving piano and drum-programming focus. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/theo-parrish-wuddaji/
